title: A Controlled Study of Models, Skills, Feedback, and Curriculum in Agentic Robotics
title_zh: 智能体机器人学中模型、技能、反馈与课程设计的受控研究

paragraphs.en: 通过631种配置的受控仿真研究，发现智能体机器人自学习的关键瓶颈在于失败归因与策略代码重构能力。 Agentic robotics asks coding agents to implement and iteratively improve robot policies from simulated and real-world physical interactions. We study the self-learning loop of agentic robotics through a controlled simulation study spanning nine manipulation tasks, 631 different experiment configurations, and 28K coding agent rollouts, systematically varying model capability, skill priors, feedback structure, and curriculum. The experiment data suggests that the bottleneck is often not the access to sufficient information, but interpreting it into the right policy update. Across these factors, a successful self-learning loop depends on how effectively agents attribute failures, reason task-relevant spatial and geometric structure, and selectively restructure code to improve policies.
paragraphs.zh: 通过覆盖九个操作任务、631种实验配置和28K次智能体代码执行rollout的受控仿真研究，我们系统地变化模型能力、技能先验、反馈结构和课程设置，研究智能体机器人技术的自学习回路。 我们研究智能体机器人技术的自学习回路。 实验数据表明，瓶颈往往不在于能否获取充分的信息，而在于能否将其解读为正确的策略更新。 在这些因素中，成功的自学习回路取决于智能体归因失败、推理与任务相关的空间和几何结构，以及有选择地重构代码以改进策略的能力是否高效。
